name: suspend
description: Bulk suspend all guests on the cluster.

params.name: max-workers
params.description: Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently.

params.name: maxworkers
params.description: Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. Deprecated, use 'max-workers' instead.

params.name: statestorage
params.description: The storage for the VM state.

params.name: to-disk
params.description: If set, suspends the guests to disk. Will be resumed on next start.

params.name: vms
params.description: Only consider guests from this list of VMIDs.

permissions.description: The 'VM.PowerMgmt' permission is required on '/' or on '/vms/<ID>' for each ID passed via the 'vms' parameter. Additionally, you need 'VM.Config.Disk' on the '/vms/{vmid}' path and 'Datastore.AllocateSpace' for the configured state-storage(s)
